segments.text: WHen Ieſus came into the coaſtes of the citie which is called Ceſaria Philippi, he aſked his diſciples, ſayinge: whome do men ſaye that I the ſonne of man am? They ſayed: ſome ſaye that thou art Iohn Baptiſte, ſome Helias, ſome Ieremias, or one of the noumbre of the prophetes. He ſayeth vnto them: but whome ſay ye that I am? Simon Peter aunſwered, and ſayed: Thou art Chriſt the ſonne of the lyuing God. And Ieſus anſwered, and ſaid vnto hym. Happy art thou Simon the ſonne of Ionas, for fleſhe and bloude hath not opened that vnto thee: but my father which is in heauen. And I ſay alſo vnto thee, that thou art Peter: and vpon this rocke I wyl buylde my congregacion. And the gates of hel ſhall not preuail agaynſt it. And I wil geue vnto thee the keyes of the kingdome of heauen. And whatſoeuer thou byndeſt in earth, ſhalbe bounde in heauen: and whatſoeuer thou loceſt in earth, ſhalbe loced in heauen.
